suggestion.topic: Python AsyncIO Event Loop: Single-Threaded Concurrency Explained
suggestion.rationale: Directly targets high-volume search queries around asyncio and event loops. Bridges the conceptual gap between multi-threading and asynchronous code for intermediate Python developers seeking high-performance I/O handling.
suggestion.hook_angle: Stop using threads for I/O-bound tasks until you understand how Python's single-threaded event loop actually interleaves your coroutines.
